questions.stem: How does a cold pack used for sports injuries work?

options.text: It contains ice that melts and absorbs heat
It contains ammonium nitrate that dissolves endothermically, absorbing heat from the surroundings
It contains chemicals that react exothermically, releasing cold energy
It contains a catalyst that lowers the temperature

questions.explanation: Cold packs contain ammonium nitrate and water separated by a barrier. When squeezed, they mix and the salt dissolves endothermically, absorbing heat from the surroundings and causing a drop in temperature.

questions.stem: During any chemical reaction, what happens to the bonds in the reactants and products?

options.text: Bonds in reactants are formed and bonds in products are broken
Bonds in both reactants and products are broken
Bonds in reactants are broken and new bonds in products are formed
No bonds are broken or formed; atoms simply rearrange

questions.explanation: In a chemical reaction, bonds in the reactants must first be broken (which requires energy) and then new bonds in the products are formed (which releases energy). The overall energy change depends on the difference between these two processes.
